messages:
deploy-bot: auto-rollback triggered for rollout v2.14.0 -> trigger: dedicated-pool 5xx spike (db-conn-errors >= 1.8% over 5m). scheduling rollback to v2.13.6 and starting traffic reassignment. :rotating_light:
meera: STOP the global rollback. BigBank (dedicated pool) just pinged — their requests are failing and they specifically asked us to avoid a full rollback because it would disrupt SLA-backed batch jobs. they want us to keep their pool on the current binary while we collect traces.
jordan: +1. we should not reassign dedicated hosts for BigBank. propose: cancel global rollback steps that touch dedicated pools, pin BigBank's pool to v2.13.6 for customer-facing endpoints only, keep the shared hosted canary at 10% on v2.14.0 for trace capture.
ops-oncall: rollback job 1744956789 is 33% complete. queued tasks: drain dedicated hosts in eu-west-1-dedicated, update LB rules for dedicated -> hosted fallback. need explicit approval to stop these steps.
deploy-bot: rollback job is interruptible. manual override accepted if approver identity provided. note: automated guard will re-enable after suppression window unless extended.
devops-lucy: i approve targeted suppression for BigBank. ops-oncall please execute: `deployctl cancel-job 1744956789 --remaining` and `deployctl pin-pool --pool bigbank-eu --version v2.13.6 --reason "customer requested preserve dedicated pool"`. Also set hosted canary to 10% for v2.14.0 and increase tracing.
ops-oncall: running commands now: `deployctl cancel-job 1744956789 --remaining` -> success. `deployctl pin-pool --pool bigbank-eu --version v2.13.6 --reason "customer requested preserve dedicated pool"` -> success, audit id pin-77a1. `deployctl set-canary --scope hosted --version v2.14.0 --percent 10` -> success. suppression window set to 3h; auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1744967589 unless extended.
meera: please also snapshot the dedicated pool KV + metrics and preserve logs for 7 days (customer compliance asks). tag them `bigbank-dedicated-174495`.
ops-oncall: KV snapshot created `kv-bigbank-pre-174495`. log retention extended 7d; tags applied.
support-ana: drafting customer note: "BigBank — we're investigating intermittent DB connection errors affecting a subset of your requests. To avoid disrupting scheduled jobs, we will preserve your dedicated pool while we collect traces and logs. We expect an update in 4 hours." want me to send?
meera: send it. cc their SRE and our account lead. include incident ref INC-2024-9001.
jordan: ML/infra tasks: bump trace sampling to 100% for the dedicated pool for 1h, enable DB client debug logs on dedicated hosts, and collect host-level metrics (fd counts, connection pools). creating ticket INFRA-4981.
ops-oncall: additional note: there was a midnight maintenance window scheduled at 1744963200 for node reboots in eu-west-1. pause that until the suppression window is cleared to avoid compounding changes.
deploy-bot: suppression recorded by devops-lucy, reason "customer requested preserve dedicated pool", audit pin-77a1. auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1744967589. :lock:
jordan: if we confirm it's an infra DB client regression, we prefer flipping a DB client config on affected hosts and quick canary instead of full rollback. if it's model binary, then model-only revert on dedicated hosts first.
meera: good. keep all chatter here. if we need to flip global traffic later we'll run the rollback checklist and notify sales/support before action. closing for now — monitoring leads assigned. :white_check_mark:
